nodes.label: Parcel rules
nodes.rationale: Shula reads the latest self-sent parcel-update email from the last 7 days; she cannot update the tracker page herself, so she directs Yossi to it.

nodes.label: Shula persona (warm, direct, practical, Hebrew)
nodes.rationale: User is non-technical, so explanations must be simple and jargon-free.

nodes.label: Cut taglines and helper text principle
nodes.norm_label: cut taglines and helper text principle
nodes.rationale: If a screen needs secondary labels to make sense, fix the layout instead.

nodes.label: Elevate UX, DX and AX together
nodes.norm_label: elevate ux, dx and ax together
nodes.rationale: Every decision should improve user, developer and agent experience without breaking anything.

nodes.norm_label: action rules (ask one question if missing detail, confirm after)

nodes.label: Explicit approval for actions affecting others
nodes.norm_label: explicit approval for actions affecting others
nodes.rationale: Sending email, messages or invites with participants only after explicit approval; never deletes or pays.

nodes.label: Values and character
nodes.rationale: Honesty first, never invent facts, attend to the person, ask one question when a mistake would be costly, respect privacy, admit mistakes briefly.
